notes.title: New Game Announcement (Catwink) + Earth Overclocked 80% Off
notes.notes:
We're putting Earth Overclocked on sale for 80% off as part of the Steam Endless Replayability Fest!

In other news, after years of hiatus we finally have a new game to announce, to be released later this year! It's called Catwink, a casual card-matching party game where every card matched activates an effect. It's our own take on classic card games like Crazy Eights and its contemporaries.

[previewyoutube=NZvZN-ly0AI;full][/previewyoutube]

Take extra turns, redraw your hand, force other players to draw cards, copy other players' actions, and more! Not only do these card effects change up the game on every turn, but a Hot Potato sort of mechanic occasionally makes its rounds as well. When a player is being forced to draw cards, they can deflect the attack to other players by matching cards like Skip and Reverse, in addition to being able to stack the draw penalty!

You can wishlist Catwink here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356870/Catwink/

We may also have other projects coming up. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Bad News About Earth Overclocked
notes.notes:
I am afraid to announce that, after the Linux port and the AI update, Earth Overclocked will not be receiving future major content patches. This means that the Trials expansion has been canceled.

I apologies for this bad news. There are two major reasons why this decision has been made, both listed below.

[b]1. Both the software used to make the game and the engine itself are unreliable.[/b]
  Since this was the first really big project that the team has made, a lot of mistakes were made during the development of the game, leading to unstable code that is now difficult to maintain support for regarding future content patches. There is also the fact that we are rather unhappy with the software we used to create the game, GameMaker: Studio. GameMaker: Studio is fantastic for creating small, simple games in a very small amount of time. After 3 grueling years of working on Earth Overclocked, however, we learned the hard way that this software isn't well-structured for large projects. I understand that large successful games have been made with this software such as Undertale and Hotline Miami, and good for the developers that pulled that off, but the programmers in the Chronicle Bench team have not really enjoyed using the software ourselves to make a big game.
  There is also the problem that as GameMaker: Studio receives more and more updates, it becomes more and more unstable. It has way more bugs than it did a few years ago and my team is basically fed up with poor treatment of the software.
  In fact I just loaded up GameMaker: Studio today after a long time of not using it, ready to finish off the AI update and release it after this weekend, and was greeted with this error constantly spamming my screen: 

[img]https://i.gyazo.com/91b5b3399a4c150a24822d27289f6df8.png[/img]

[b]2. We are putting full attention into an entirely new, completely different game.[/b]
  Right after the full launch of Earth Overclocked, my team has started development for a simple turn-based RPG called Coded Universe. You can read our devlog here: https://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=54417.0
We are excited to be making this game, since it is my true dream game that tells a very personal story of mine which I created when I was younger. It is dedicated to my coding partner and best friend Aaron Griffin, whom I met through the roleplay that created this story and is currently helping me make Coded Universe a reality. My team wants to put full-focus into this game, and in order to do this we need to move on from Earth Overclocked, which we already completed anyways.

The AI update will still be coming and I will still try to get a Linux port out as well as fix any future bug reports, but major content patches are no longer going to be occurring.

notes.title: Upcoming "Enemy AI" Update
notes.notes:
As stated in an earlier news post, before we work on the free Trials Expansion for Earth Overclocked, we want to improve the game. Chronicle Bench has decided to make a pre-expansion update that will focus on enhancing enemy AI. The goal is to ensure that every enemy and boss in the game feel very different from each other. We feel that this improvement will be the most beneficial one for the upcoming expansion.

So be prepared for this update! You may have to change your game plan a bit with the new enemy AI patterns. Some will be smarter, some will be more passive, and some will be completely different altogether.

Here is a demo showcasing the new Plant Wizard AI in Earth Overclocked's secret testing chamber. They now ignore the player completely and mind their own business, but are a bit more aggressive with their minion summoning. Try to avoid getting surrounded!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NzNiD-TB80E

notes.title: Technical Issues (SOLVED)
notes.notes:
EDIT: We just released a version of the game that was compiled under an older version of Steam SDK in order to fix the "game not starting" issue on the latest version of the Steam client. The game will run on the latest version of Steam now. There is a small bug involving the game crashing when you try to exit normally, and we'll look into it later. All we know is that this bug is Steam related, and it's pretty harmless.

---------------------

Apparently a Steam update was released that completely keeps our game from operating with Steam, thus keeping the game from working.

We believe it is a Steam-sided issue and will clear this out ASAP.

UPDATE: There is a workaround for Windows users. In the steamapps folder for the game, delete the steam_api.dll. This does mean that achievements won't be obtainable for now.

UPDATE 2: We are recompiling the game under an older Steam SDK to see if this works.

UPDATE 3: It works, but there appears to be a bug. The game crashes when you attempt to exit the normal way. We're trying to address this now, then make it publicly available.

notes.title: January 22 Update Rolled Back, MASSIVE Apologies For Lost Saves, New Save Recovery Program
notes.notes:
A small update we released a few days ago was apparently deleting people's saves. Whoever has played the game since the update on January 22 has lost their save files. This is a deep apologies from the team.

We just released a January 26 update for Windows that mimics the January 7th update. The Mac version was rolled back to the January 7th update directly.

[b]WE ARE ALSO OFFERING TO CREATE SAVES BASED ON EARNED ACHIEVEMENTS FOR THOSE AFFECTED! FRIEND ME ON STEAM AND I WILL SEND YOU RECOVERED SAVES![/b]

This is a new low for us and we sincerely apologize for the screwup. You have every right to be mad, and I will do what I can to fix this. Please friend me and I will give you saves with restored progress. It's a good thing that Steam achievements are a thing, at least.

We will fix almost all damage caused to customers and ensure that this won't happen again.

EDIT: Note that it is not possible for me to recover scores and statistics, only the unlockable content.

notes.title: Expansion Announced: Trials
notes.notes:
The poll we submitted about a month ago concerning the Earth Overclocked free expansion is now a very close split between the two modes, Trials and Endless Dungeon. Chronicle Bench will now break the split.

EXPANSION THEME: TRIALS
The Earth Overclocked free expansion will feature a brand new mode called Trials, which puts the player in a variety of different preset combat scenarios. We will reveal more information about the mode over time, but the expansion will also feature some extra goodies.

BEFORE THE EXPANSION...
Before we work on the expansion, there are two major problems with Earth Overclocked right now that we want to address: some issues with the game that have been brought to our attention, and the lack of a Linux port. Expect a few updates in the near future to improve Earth Overclocked based on feedback. At the same time, we will be trying to get Earth Overclocked working on Linux.

THE CORRUPT SAVE PROBLEM
We are aware that the game cannot save your progress properly on a small group of machines, making the game practically unplayable for this group of users. We are working on a solution to this problem. For now, if you experience the bug (you will get either an error about data structures or a corrupt save message on game startup), you are encouraged to refund the game.

notes.title: First Free Expansion Poll: Trials vs Endless Dungeon
notes.notes:
A bug fix patch is coming to Earth Overclocked soon! We were going to release it on Christmas, but then Steam had that really weird screwup.

In the meantime, next year I will be working on Earth Overclocked's first free expansion! We have two ideas for the expansion, but I would like to know what is a more popular idea from you guys.

[b]Trials[/b]
Trials is a level-based mode where each level puts you in a combat scenario against a theme of enemies with certain weapons. For example, in "Obligatory Zombie Apocalypse," You fight hordes of zombies and skeletons with a chainsaw and shotgun. In "Tree Bros.," you fight immobile Tree Monster and Treebot at the same time with nothing but a tree branch. Some trials also force you to survive without any offensive capability. In the Trials game mode, most of your assigned weapons are much stronger than the ones in the other game modes, but enemies come in hordes.

[b]Endless Dungeon[/b]
Endless Dungeon is a dungeon with an infinite amount of floors, each one more difficult than the last and introducing new enemies to deal with. The theme switches every few floors, which changes up the enemy pools a bit. Floors are typically smaller than the single floor dungeons found in Earth Overclocked's Distorted Earth and Earth Unleashed game modes. Your objective is to descend as far as you can.

You can vote on the straw poll below. The one with the most votes after an unspecified time period will be the theme of the expansion.

VVVVVVVVVVVVVVVVVV
http://strawpoll.me/6369125

notes.title: Final Day of Early Access
notes.notes:
After 3 and a half years of development and a little over 3 months of being in Early Access, we are finally at the end of the road for this game. The Chronicle Bench team has had some bad moments, but we have a lot more good memories, such as coming up with the story and concept of the game, designing bosses and weapons, and even some silliness.

This marks the final day that Earth Overclocked has its beta tag, and then we launch for real. You may be wondering, "What will happen from here?" Well, while the game won't be very active in development after tomorrow's launch, this doesn't mean that the game will completely cease development. Sometime after release and the team has a break, we will be looking into post-release content for Earth Overclocked, such as new modes and weapons.

I still advise not buying the game until tomorrow because of the first week launch discount. This is the final warning that I will give. Put it on your wishlist for now.

notes.title: Pre-Release Out For Those Who Own Beta Package
notes.notes:
We would like to announce that a pre-release build of version 1.0 of the game is now available for those who own the beta package of Earth Overclocked. After restarting the Steam client and allowing Earth Overclocked to update, when you run the game from the client you should get a new option called "Pre-Release Review Copy." Clicking on it opens up version 1.0.

Please be aware that this option ONLY works for Windows users who own the beta package! It should throw a missing executable error for everyone else. (The majority of the players.) If you are wondering what package you own: if you bought the game from the store or another store, or received a code from us after August 24th but before November 27th (today's date), you own the normal package and not the beta one.

For reviewers, we highly encourage looking at the pre-release review copy (version 1.0.0.0) over the one in early access (version 0.9.3.2), since it is an accurate representation of the final game. We will be sending out review keys starting soon.

notes.title: Earth Overclocked 0.9.3 "Local Multiplayer Update" is Live!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pE_haL3UVwk
[b]V1.0 RELEASE DATE INCLUDED IN ABOVE TRAILER[/b]

[h1]0.9.3 (Windows), 0.9.6 (Mac OS X) (November 14, 2015)
"Local Multiplayer Update"[/h1]
-Added Local Multiplayer BETA game mode!
--Up to 4 players locally, use both keyboard and gamepads, or gamepads only
--Everyone works together as a team to win, or die trying
--Difficulty scales based on number of players
--Loot scales based on number of players
--Everyone plays in a different suit
--Requires at least one gamepad
--The extra players are NOT simple 'companions' to Player 1, and have their own stats and weapon inventories!
--Everything besides game modes and extra suits is already unlocked in multiplayer. Have fun with every weapon and power card while playing with your friends!
-Added stat comparison displays (and a new option for them)!
-Raised the timer to 20 minutes for Distorted Earth, 15 minutes for Earth Unleashed!
-Renamed "Unlockables" to "Single Player Unlockables"
-Improved pre-rendering performance
-Made the player gasp when he sees a Creepymonster
-Fixes to DPS calculator
-Added 4 skill achievements (Steam Only)
-Added options to the pause screen
-The forest biome has alternate tiles
-Raised the volume of the Wubb weapon
-Added tooltips for the options
-Outlined the key count red or yellow based on its value
-Added the rest of the patches
-Fixed a bug with stitches and preloading
-Made the interface pulse in the presence of mortal danger
-The Meiun final boss battle is more difficult
-The boss in Final Malfunction has slightly more base health
-Paintball Gun randomizes its colors
-Added an easter egg for taking no damage in a run
-Fixed the price of the Stinger
-Lowered the price of Pistol and Seeker
-Added a softer damage sound for puddle weapons, explosions, and attacks of less than 3 damage
-Other small changes and fixes

notes.title: WARNING: Price Will Increase Soon!
notes.notes:
I am giving this out as a warning. Between the 0.9.3 update and full release, the price of the game will increase by 25%! (This number can vary based on currency.) However, this will NOT be your last chance for getting the game at its current price, since we plan on doing a full release discount equal to the Early Access price. So if you feel like you need more time to decide, no worries!

I would also like to say that the new local multiplayer mode coming in 0.9.3 is pretty chaotic. ;)

EDIT: I would also like to clarify that the new price will be the final price for the game.

notes.title: Slight Change in Plans
notes.notes:
I would like to announce a change in plans. We have decided to combine the 0.9.2.2 update with the 0.9.3 update and release their content at the same time. Remember as we said earlier, this will be the final major update before we prepare for full release. A new trailer showing off the new local multiplayer aspect of the game, and also announcing the full release date of Earth Overclocked, will be launched alongside 0.9.3. The full release, version 1.0, will include the rest of the polishing changes and access to the Conclusion game mode for those who have unlocked it, as well as a revamped save system so that your saves will be compatible across computers and work with Steam Cloud.

Will there be updates after the full release, you may be asking? Well we would love to add more bonus features and content, but we need support from the fans! The more the game grows in popularity, the more we can update it. Help us spread the word!

notes.title: Multiplayer Is Almost Done!
notes.notes:
After some hard work and sweat, the Multiplayer mode is almost finished. Here is what to expect for Multiplayer in v0.9.3:
[list]
[*]Up to four players locally with any combination of Keyboard + Mouse and four Gamepads!
[*]Players cooperate and share coins and keys.
[*]You start with more coins and keys with more players.
[*]The maximum number of keys that can be held goes up with the number of players.
[*]The number of enemies and pickups increase.
[*]Bosses have their health multiplied.
[*]Multiplayer does not contribute to certain unlockables, and can be played in Distorted Earth or Earth Unleashed.
[*]Each player can be named and have unique control schemes.
[*]A highscore and best time to beat for each playthrough!
[*]Competition between players is planned for later updates.
[/list]
Concerning the next update, v0.9.2.2 (v0.9.6 for Mac), weapon stats will be visibly displayed and can be compared during gameplay. This can help you decide which would be better weapons for you without expending durability testing them. Alternate tiles for each biome will assist the patches in making the biomes not look flat. And of course there's a bunch of tweaks included with v0.9.2.2.

v0.9.2.2 will be coming out relatively soon, while Multiplayer will require a lot of testing before being opened in v0.9.3. I hope you will have lots of fun with your friends!

EDIT: Here's a picture!
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CRjUJzhWwAAdBZE.png:large[/img]

notes.title: Some Of Our Current Plans
notes.notes:
Now that we have launched 0.9.2, the "Elemental Update," and varied up the gameplay, here are some of our current plans for the remainder of the game's beta period.

[b]Between 0.9.2 and 0.9.3[/b]
Leading up to 0.9.3, we will be releasing a series of small updates to polish up the game. This includes more decorations in dungeons, interesting environmental additions and hazards in the overworld, new atmospheric sounds, and visual bug fixes with weapons, along with some more helpful things like visual stat comparisons between equipped weapons with weapons on the ground. We will also be working on fixing major bugs, and adding suggestions from the playerbase.

[b]0.9.3 "Multiplayer Update"[/b]
The 0.9.3 update will be focused on a new Multiplayer mode, which will let you play the main game with up to four players locally. We are still discussing what else will be included in this update and what will be saved for the game's full release, but we have ideas in the air.

If enough suggestions come in from the playerbase, we may possibly do an additional 0.9.4 update before full release.

That is basically all we have to share for now. The team is currently taking a break since the 0.9.2 release, but we will be starting back up work soon!

~Justin Priester

notes.title: Dashing and Multiplayer Progress
notes.notes:
Dashing in action.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zTj6NTh.gif[/img]

Here are the full mechanics: you can only dash once per second, and the dash will give you a slight speed boost, but you will have to commit to the direction you chose. If you stand still and press the dash button (default Spacebar or RB on Xbox controllers), you will dash toward your cursor. Otherwise, you dash in the direction you are currently walking in.

As you can see, enemies like the Sand Dweller get similar dash mechanics, but if they happen to dash into you, they will bounce away and not deal contact damage. They only bounce once, so it may be a bit tight when multiplayer comes around.

Speaking of multiplayer, Local Multiplayer is currently being worked on for v0.9.2, but it will not be available until the update after! Lots of the logic involving the player has to be refactored, not to mention that the controls have to be redone. Even then, there might be a couple of bugs when it does become available, but we hope to have them all found and fixed before final release. I promise it will be lots of fun!

~Aaron Griffin

notes.title: The time is now! Earth Overclocked released in Early Access!
notes.notes:
We're proud to say that Earth Overclocked is finally available to the public!

So now that we have launched the game in a late beta state, you're probably all wondering, "Where do we go from here?"

Well, first of all we want to focus on making the gameplay more fun and varied. All you're currently doing is pointing and whacking things, after all. While there are plenty of things to beat around, it does get pretty old after a while. Here are our current plans for the near future!

[b]DASHING[/b]
The player will be given the ability to make a quick dash in any direction. This gives you more mobility for dodging attacks and maneuvering around monsters, and it can also be used to move around faster. Of course, why does only the player get to dash? That isn't fair!
Fear not; many monsters will also be getting this ability! Each monster who can dash will utilize dashing maneuvers in different ways. Whether to get closer to the player, hop to the other side of the player, or dodge attacks, monsters will be far trickier to deal with.

[b]MONSTER ARENAS[/b]
Running around flipping switches in dungeons can be boring. Here is something that will fix that: monster arenas. Some switches will spawn in special room layouts. When one of these switches is flipped, you will be blocked into the room and enemies will spawn in waves. Defeat all monsters to open the way out, as well as the colored gate that the switch was connected to. Previously you only fought bosses in enclosed spaces, but not anymore! With limited mobility, you will need to think a bit differently to survive in these arenas.

[b]MORE ELITE ELEMENTALS[/b]
Currently there are 3 different Elite Elementals in the game. Elite Elementals are stronger versions of normal monsters with additional abilities, such as creating walls of fire or surrounding themselves with pools of water. As of right now these monsters only appear in the mode Earth Unleashed. We would like to bring Elite Elementals to the normal game mode as well while keeping them as a differing factor in Earth Unleashed. It has been decided to create 3 more Elite Elementals, totaling the amount to 6. All 6 Elite Elementals will appear in Earth Unleashed, while only half of them are selected to appear in the main game mode every run.

We have more ideas behind the scenes. If you have suggestions, feel free to share! We take into consideration all feedback!
